title: PLA Sorties Steady at 3, All Cross Median Line Into N/SW ADIZ Sectors Again
detail: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense detected 3 PLA aircraft sorties, 8 PLAN vessels and 7 official ships operating around Taiwan in the 24-hour window ending 06:00 (UTC+8) on August 23, 2026 — matching the prior day's count. All 3 sorties again crossed the Taiwan Strait median line, entering the northern and southwestern sectors of Taiwan's ADIZ, continuing the pattern seen since Han Kuang 42 concluded on August 14. ROC Armed Forces said they continued to monitor the situation with combat air patrol aircraft, naval ships and coastal missile systems.

title: Lai Marks 68th Anniversary of 823 Artillery Bombardment: 'Peace Is Secured Through Strength'
detail: President Lai Ching-te visited Kinmen on August 23, 2026 to mark the 68th anniversary of the 1958 Second Taiwan Strait Crisis, speaking in heavy rain at a memorial ceremony at Taiwushan Veterans Cemetery. Lai said the 44-day, roughly 475,000-shell bombardment of Kinmen in 1958 proved that 'peace is secured through strength,' and that 'peace agreements achieved through the sacrifice of sovereignty or submissive capitulation generate only humiliation, never genuine peace.' He said Taiwan's resolve to defend its sovereignty 'must never waver' and that not even an inch of territory can be sacrificed, adding that for 68 years China had not stopped its 'ambitions for external expansion for even a single day.' Lai used the occasion to call for sustained cross-party support for the record NT$1.1225 trillion (~US$35.3B) 2027 defense budget.
